Class encapsulating a multidimensional raster dataset (experimental)

Source: R/gdalmultidimraster.R
GDALMultiDimRaster-class.Rd

GDALMultiDimRaster provides an interface for accessing a dataset in the GDAL Multidimensional Raster Data Model (https://gdal.org/en/stable/user/multidim_raster_data_model.html), such as netCDF, HDF5 or Zarr. An object of class GDALMultiDimRaster persists an open connection to the dataset and its root group, and exposes methods to:

  • retrieve dataset information

  • list the groups and arrays in a group

  • describe the dimensions of a group or an array

  • read the attributes of a group or an array.

Groups, arrays and dimensions are addressed by their full path from the root group, e.g., "/", "/group/subgroup" or "/group/temperature". A path without a leading "/" is taken from the root. Groups and dimensions are returned as plain R lists and data frames. Methods to open and read an array (class GDALMDArray) will be added in a later release.

This class is experimental. Its interface may change in future releases. Requires GDAL >= 3.2.

GDALMultiDimRaster is a C++ class exposed directly to R (via RCPP_EXPOSED_CLASS). Fields and methods of the class are accessed using the $ operator. Note that all arguments to class methods are required and must be given in the order documented. Naming the arguments is optional but may be preferred for readability.

In this documentation, "attributes" always means GDAL attributes, i.e., metadata stored on groups and arrays in the dataset, not R object attributes.

Usage (see Details)

## Constructors
# read-only by default:
ds <- new(GDALMultiDimRaster, filename)
# for update access:
ds <- new(GDALMultiDimRaster, filename, read_only = FALSE)
# to use dataset open options:
ds <- new(GDALMultiDimRaster, filename, read_only, open_options)
# to open in shared mode, or restrict the candidate drivers:
ds <- new(GDALMultiDimRaster, filename, read_only, open_options, shared,
          allowed_drivers)

## Read/write fields
ds$infoOptions
ds$quiet

## Methods
ds$getFilename()
ds$open(read_only)
ds$isOpen()
ds$isReadOnly()
ds$getDriverShortName()
ds$getDriverLongName()
ds$getFileList()
ds$info()

ds$getGroupNames(path)
ds$getMDArrayNames(path)
ds$getDimensions(path)
ds$getAttributes(path)
ds$getGroupInfo(path)

ds$close()

Details

Constructors

new(GDALMultiDimRaster, filename)
Constructor for read-only access. filename is a character string containing the file name or other data source name (DSN) of a multidimensional raster, e.g., a netCDF file, a Zarr store given as ZARR:"/vsicurl/https://...", or a multidimensional VRT. Returns an object of class GDALMultiDimRaster, or an error is raised if the dataset cannot be opened in multidimensional mode.

new(GDALMultiDimRaster, filename, read_only)
Constructor specifying read/write access (read_only = TRUE|FALSE).

new(GDALMultiDimRaster, filename, read_only, open_options)
Constructor specifying dataset open_options as a character vector of NAME=VALUE pairs.

new(GDALMultiDimRaster, filename, read_only, open_options, shared, allowed_drivers)
Constructor to open the dataset in shared mode (shared = TRUE), and/or to give allowed_drivers as a character vector of driver short names that must be considered when opening filename. All arguments are required in this form of the constructor, but open_options and allowed_drivers may be NULL.

Read/write fields

$infoOptions
A character vector of command-line arguments for gdalmdiminfo used by the $info() method (see below), e.g., c("-detailed", "-limit", "5"). Defaults to an empty vector (no options).

$quiet
A logical value, TRUE to suppress progress reporting and other console output from class methods. Defaults to FALSE. Reserved for methods added in later releases.

Methods

$getFilename()
Returns a character string containing the filename associated with this GDALMultiDimRaster object.

$open(read_only)
(Re-)opens the dataset on the existing filename. Use this method to open a dataset that has been closed using $close(). May be used to re-open a dataset with a different read/write access (read_only set to TRUE or FALSE). The method will first close an open dataset, so it is not required to call $close() explicitly in this case. No return value, called for side effects.

$isOpen()
Returns logical TRUE if the dataset is open, otherwise FALSE.

$isReadOnly()
Returns logical TRUE if the dataset is open read-only, or FALSE if opened for update.

$getDriverShortName()
Returns the short name of the GDAL driver used to open the dataset (e.g., "netCDF", "Zarr").

$getDriverLongName()
Returns the long name of the GDAL driver used to open the dataset.

$getFileList()
Returns a character vector of files believed to be part of the dataset. If it returns an empty string ("") it means there is believed to be no local file system files associated with the dataset (e.g., a virtual file system).

$info()
Prints various information about the dataset to the console, as JSON output from the gdalmdiminfo utility, using the options given in $infoOptions. No return value, called for that side effect. See also mdim_info(), which returns the information as a character string.

$getGroupNames(path)
Returns a character vector containing the names of the sub-groups directly under the group at path (a character string giving the full path of a group, e.g., "/" for the root group). Returns an empty vector if there are no sub-groups. An error is raised if no group is found at path.

$getMDArrayNames(path)
Returns a character vector containing the names of the arrays in the group at path. Coordinate variables (indexing variables of dimensions) are included. An error is raised if no group is found at path.

$getDimensions(path)
Returns a data frame describing the dimensions of the group or the array at path. For an array, rows are in the array's own dimension order (slowest varying first). For a group, rows are the dimensions defined in that group, in the order returned by the driver. The data frame has columns:

  • name: the dimension name

  • full_name: the full path of the dimension

  • size: the dimension size (numeric)

  • type: the dimension type, e.g., "HORIZONTAL_X", "HORIZONTAL_Y", "VERTICAL", "TEMPORAL", or "" if unknown

  • direction: the dimension direction, e.g., "EAST", "NORTH", "FUTURE", or "" if unknown

  • indexing_variable: the full path of the array holding the coordinate values of the dimension, or "" if there is none.

A path is first looked up as a group, then as an array. An error is raised if neither is found.

$getAttributes(path)
Returns a named list of the attributes of the group or the array at path. Values are converted by attribute data type: string attributes are returned as character, integer attributes that fit in 32 bits as integer, other numeric attributes as double, and attributes of compound or complex data type as raw (the bytes as stored). Multi-valued attributes are returned as vectors. Returns an empty list if there are no attributes. Note that some drivers report certain attributes through dedicated properties of an array instead (e.g., the netCDF driver hides units, _FillValue, scale_factor and add_offset, which will be available from methods of class GDALMDArray). A path is first looked up as a group, then as an array. An error is raised if neither is found.

$getGroupInfo(path)
Returns a named list describing the group at path, with elements name, full_name, group_names, array_names, dimensions (a data frame as returned by $getDimensions()), and attributes (a list as returned by $getAttributes()). An error is raised if no group is found at path.

$close()
Closes the dataset and the root group. No return value, called for side effects.

See also

mdim_info(), mdim_translate(), mdim_as_classic()

GDAL Multidimensional Raster Data Model:
https://gdal.org/en/stable/user/multidim_raster_data_model.html

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata/mdim_small.nc", package="gdalraster")
ds <- new(GDALMultiDimRaster, f)
ds
#> C++ object of class <GDALMultiDimRaster>
#>   • Driver: Network Common Data Format (netCDF)
#>   • Filename:
#>   "/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/mdim_small.nc"
#>   • Access: read-only
#>   • Groups in root: 1
#>   • Arrays in root: 4 (lat, lon, time, t2m)

ds$getGroupNames("/")
#> [1] "ocean"
ds$getMDArrayNames("/")
#> [1] "lat"  "lon"  "time" "t2m" 
ds$getMDArrayNames("/ocean")
#> [1] "sst"

ds$getDimensions("/")
#>   name full_name size         type direction indexing_variable
#> 1  lat      /lat    5 HORIZONTAL_Y     NORTH              /lat
#> 2  lon      /lon    6 HORIZONTAL_X      EAST              /lon
#> 3 time     /time    4     TEMPORAL                       /time
ds$getDimensions("/t2m")
#>   name full_name size         type direction indexing_variable
#> 1 time     /time    4     TEMPORAL                       /time
#> 2  lat      /lat    5 HORIZONTAL_Y     NORTH              /lat
#> 3  lon      /lon    6 HORIZONTAL_X      EAST              /lon

ds$getAttributes("/")
#> $Conventions
#> [1] "CF-1.8"
#> 
#> $resolution
#> [1] 0.25
#> 
#> $title
#> [1] "gdalraster multidim test dataset"
#> 
#> $version
#> [1] 1
#> 
ds$getAttributes("/time")
#> $calendar
#> [1] "standard"
#> 
#> $standard_name
#> [1] "time"
#> 

str(ds$getGroupInfo("/ocean"))
#> List of 6
#>  $ name       : chr "ocean"
#>  $ full_name  : chr "/ocean"
#>  $ group_names: chr(0) 
#>  $ array_names: chr "sst"
#>  $ dimensions :'data.frame':	0 obs. of  6 variables:
#>   ..$ name             : chr(0) 
#>   ..$ full_name        : chr(0) 
#>   ..$ size             : num(0) 
#>   ..$ type             : chr(0) 
#>   ..$ direction        : chr(0) 
#>   ..$ indexing_variable: chr(0) 
#>  $ attributes :List of 1
#>   ..$ source: chr "synthetic"

ds$infoOptions <- c("-array", "t2m", "-detailed", "-limit", "2")
ds$info()
